function: no_learning: OTFS channel estimation by off-grid structured sparse Bayesian learning solved with EM iterations, plus compressive-sensing and closed-form ML detectors; no trained model (p. 1, p. 8).
notes: Reason no_learning. Title and DOI on p. 1 match. The methods are model-based: secondary detection with CS algorithms (p. 6: "mature and low-complexity CS algorithms such as orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP), compressive sampling matching pursuit (CoSaMP), and iterative hard thresholding (IHT)"); an off-grid structured SBL estimator whose hyperparameters are re-estimated per received frame (p. 8: "We adopt the expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm to estimate the α ... is iteratively maximized"); and a closed-form symbol-wise ML detector (p. 9: "the SWIC detector does not require any iteration"). SBL here is iterative Bayesian inference with no training data and no trained parameters; no neural network or deep unfolding appears anywhere. Not source_type or survey (research article proposing and simulating methods). For reference only: had it been learned it would fall in area 4 (IRS-aided OTFS, single-antenna BS and user, 28 GHz, p. 2 and p. 10).
